loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.bar: AppHeader bg var(--bgColor-inset) (light #f6f8fa, dark #010409); inset bottom 1px borderColor-default; globalBar padding 16px, gap 12px => 64px tall bar
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.searchButton: border 1px --button-default-borderColor-rest (#d1d9e0 light); padding 5px 31px; transparent bg; placeholder fgColor-muted, line-height 20px; leading magnifier 16x16 at top 8px left 8px, fgColor-muted
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.kbd: 16x16, 12px, border 1px solid fgColor-muted, radius 3px, transparent bg, display inline-grid
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.trailingAction: 24x24 at top 4px right 4px, radius 3px, preceded by a 1px x 16px divider (borderColor-default)
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.breakpoint: width <= 1011.98px: the regular box is hidden and the narrow icon button shows; when expanded the search becomes position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100% over the bar
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.actions: gap 8px; a 1px x 20px divider before the action group; actions and Copilot group hidden at width <= 767.98px
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.iconButtons: 32x32, border 1px button-default-borderColor-rest, radius 6px, fgColor-muted; unread dot 8x8 fgColor-accent at top-right with a 2px ring of the header bg
loggedInAppHeaderFromCss.overlay: .search-suggestions: top -14px; left -14px; width calc(100% + 26px); padding-top 12px; radius 12px; max-height 80vh; z-index 35. .dark-backdrop: overlay-backdrop-bgColor, z-index 32
